Thanks for the call earlier. Attached is our DPA with suggested redlines (MountainHealth_DPA_Redlines_v2.docx). We need to close the following items before legal can sign the order form:

- Controller/Processor roles: request explicit processor subprocessor list and confirmation we are controller for patient PII.

We have a tight procurement window — procurement needs final legal signoff by 2026-11-03.

Attaching an evidence index template (evidence-index.csv) for ease. Happy to jump on a 30 min call tomorrow if helpful.

Thanks,

Subject: Re: MountainHealth DPA redlines - prioritized asks and evidence owners

Thanks Jordan — reviewed the redlines attached. High level prioritization and recommended disposition below (we should use this to stage responses to MountainHealth and to Ben for the order form tie-ins):

1) Role definition & liability language (HIGH) — MountainHealth asserts controller role for patient PII; they want a clearer liability waterfall in SCCs. Proposed action: Accept controller/processor split as requested where it aligns with our data flows; reject any unconstrained liability cap increases. Draft alternate clause for liability waterfall and send with rationale. Owner: Laura (legal).

2) SCCs selection (HIGH) — Accept using EU SCCs but ask for specific Subset 2 modifications. We will provide standard Redwood Supplement with the changed language. Owner: Irene to prepare supplement and map to order form.

3) KMS / customer-managed keys (MEDIUM) — Current hosted offering supports Redwood-managed keys; CMK is possible for Dedicated or Private deployment only. Proposed action: Offer a technical alternative: (a) Dedicated CMK add-on or (b) documented cryptographic boundary + HSM audit evidence for hosted. Owner: Ben (ops) + Irene (privacy) to explain.

4) Data residency & transfer addendum (HIGH) — Provide transfer addendum for EU clinics referencing SCCs + documented flow. Need to confirm which regions their clinics operate in. Owner: Ben (ops).

5) Retention & deletion (LOW-MEDIUM) — We can commit to a retention schedule mapped to Order Form; provide process for deletion confirmation (API + ops confirmation). Owner: Ben.

Evidence we can provide immediately: SOC 2 Type II report summary (redacted), subprocessor inventory (current CSV), KMS architecture doc (hosted), security whitepaper. Evidence we cannot provide without procurement review: CMK hosting plan (requires Dedicated/Private procurement).

Timeline suggestion: internal answers by EOD 10/26; consolidated response to MountainHealth by 10/26 evening or 10/27 morning so we keep their 11/03 signoff runway. If they accept the Dedicated CMK option that will shift procurement to a reserved capacity discussion.

I'll draft the prioritized redline cover note for Jordan to send. Jordan — do you want me to include the SCM evidence links or keep them as attachments? I can produce a short FAQ mapping each requested evidence to a Redwood artifact.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Sr. Counsel, Contracts
Redwood Inference
